hook.text: You found a great Airbnb host. Next time, why not book directly and skip the platform fee?

buildup.text: Disintermediation is when users cut out the platform and deal directly. It's every platform's nightmare.

discovery.text: Platforms fight back with insurance, payment protection, and dispute resolution you can't get going direct.

twist.text: Thumbtack and Fiverr make it easy to find a provider but hard to communicate outside the platform.

climax.text: If a platform doesn't add ongoing value, users will eventually bypass it. Matching alone isn't enough.

punchline.text: Match, then add value forever. Or get cut out.

quiz.question: What is platform disintermediation?
options: Users bypassing the platform to deal directly
